scope: Actual bundled native background UI, supported source conversion, full evidence and build proof, acknowledgement/import/Undo, source and project guards, cancellation, discovery routing and protected Save As outcomes. No real browser layout or playback claim.

results.name: Panel mounts once with graphics conversion profiles and no automatic recovery
Missing, merely selected and unrecognized sources cannot enable an import
nes.pointer-nametable.v1: visible Preview decodes real source, shows complete evidence and leaves authoring/runtime untouched
nes.immediate-ppu-background.v1: visible Preview decodes real source, shows complete evidence and leaves authoring/runtime untouched
nes.pointer-nametable.v1: acknowledged visible import appends one excluded scene and one Undo while retaining runtime settings
nes.immediate-ppu-background.v1: acknowledged visible import appends one excluded scene and one Undo while retaining runtime settings
Background preview preserves an existing edited native Audio copy
Project changes after preview refuse import without rolling back the newer edit
Selecting a new source immediately removes stale preview, acknowledgement and export actions
Busy and failed reads cannot preview a retained prior inspection
Source change while preview is pending aborts cooperative work and prevents stale publication
Explicit cancel lets a later preview finish while an older completion stays discarded
Changing methods invalidates staged output and cannot publish an in-flight former method
Project changes during conversion reject a stale stage before showing an import
Mismatched source identity and missing static compile proof are refused
Project/evidence downloads retain distinct payloads and never load the independent viewer into the editor
Save As busy, cancellation and failure reports are accurate and preserve the preview
Late save completion cannot overwrite status for a newly selected source
nes.pointer-nametable.v1: discovery route selects and focuses background tools without previewing or importing
nes.immediate-ppu-background.v1: discovery route selects and focuses background tools without previewing or importing
Recovery controls stop editor/game keyboard propagation without blocking native control defaults
